map.ppm 和倍数怎么换算？: How do ppm and dilution factors convert?
map.ppm 是质量/体积百万分比；稀释倍数 = 原药有效浓度 / 目标有效浓度。两者: ppm is the mass/volume parts per million; the dilution factor = the active concentration of the stock / the target active concentration. Both describe "how diluted it is", so keep the units of the stock concentration consistent.

That is, divide the total active ingredient needed for the target concentration by the stock active ingredient content to get the stock amount, and the rest is the water to add. Dilution factor = stock concentration / target concentration, for crop protection mixing, aerial spraying operations and pesticide safety control.
